title: Parse the nickname table on first use
body:
`contactUploadMatching.util.ts` read and parsed `data/nicknames.csv` (about 2,700 rows) at import time. That file sits under `ContactUploadsModule`, so every process that loads the app graph paid for it on startup: each API task at boot, every vitest worker that boots `AppModule`, the MCP server and the one-off scripts. Only the contact upload job ever matches a first name against it.

This moves the parse behind a small memo. The first `firstNameAliases` call reads and parses the file, and the two lookup maps are kept for the life of the process. The file ships with the build and never changes under a running process, so each task holding its own copy is exactly right, and there is nothing to expire or invalidate. Behavior of `firstNameAliases` is unchanged; the existing tests cover it, plus one that checks each caller gets its own array, so a caller mutating its result can't change the next answer.

The contactUploads AGENTS.md notes when the file is parsed.

+    const first = firstNameAliases('robert')

+    expect(firstNameAliases('robert')).not.toContain('zzyzx')

+// data/nicknames.LICENSE.txt): rows of `name1,has_nickname,name2`. Parsed on
+// first use rather than at import, since only the upload job matches names
+// and everything else that loads the contacts graph never needs it. The file
+// ships with the build and never changes under a running process, so one
+// parse per process is the whole cost.
+let nicknameTables: NicknameTables | null = null
+
+const loadNicknameTables = (): NicknameTables => {
+  if (nicknameTables) return nicknameTables
+  const nicknamesOf = new Map<string, Set<string>>()
+  const canonicalsOf = new Map<string, Set<string>>()
+  for (const line of readFileSync(
+    path.join(__dirname, '..', 'data', 'nicknames.csv'),
+    'utf8',
   )
+    .split('\n')
+    .slice(1)) {
+    const [canonicalName, , nicknameName] = line.split(',')
+    const canonical = nameKey(canonicalName ?? null)
+    const nickname = nameKey(nicknameName ?? null)
+    if (!canonical || !nickname) continue
+    nicknamesOf.set(
+      canonical,
+      (nicknamesOf.get(canonical) ?? new Set()).add(nickname),
+    )
+    canonicalsOf.set(
+      nickname,
+      (canonicalsOf.get(nickname) ?? new Set()).add(canonical),
+    )
+  }
+  nicknameTables = { nicknamesOf, canonicalsOf }
+  return nicknameTables
 }
 
 // The first name, its nicknames and the names it is a nickname of. Never a
 // nickname's other full names' nicknames: that walk links "bob" to "bill"
 // and "ron" to "erin".
-export const firstNameAliases = (firstKey: string): string[] =>
-  [
+export const firstNameAliases = (firstKey: string): string[] => {
+  const { nicknamesOf, canonicalsOf } = loadNicknameTables()
+  return [
     ...new Set([
       firstKey,
       ...(nicknamesOf.get(firstKey) ?? []),
       ...(canonicalsOf.get(firstKey) ?? []),
     ]),
   ].sort()
+}
